SL-004 is implemented and committed as `21956eb`. All 25 tests pass and `tsc --noEmit` is clean. The slice is ready for the audit (`/speckit-sddpp-cycle-audit`). **What I did** - **Backend:** `src/app.ts` trims the title on `POST /api/tasks`. An empty result returns 400 `validation_failed` with "A title is required." Anything over 500 characters, counted after trimming, returns 400 `validation_failed` with "The title is too long (at most 500 characters)." Nothing is stored in either case, and I didn't touch the database layer. - **Frontend:** `public/index.html` has a new `

`. `public/app.js` writes the server's `error.message` into it with `textContent` when the response isn't OK. It clears the message and the input after a successful add. - I left the test files alone. **What I could not verify** - I didn't run the page in a real browser, because the project has no browser end-to-end tests. The page behavior is checked only by the tests that inspect the HTML and script text, so the on-screen message is untested. - I didn't run Stryker mutation testing. **Not done, because no test asks for it** - A request whose `title` isn't a string, or a body that isn't valid JSON, isn't validated here. `title.trim()` would throw and the server would answer 500. The architecture doc lists `invalid_json` as a 400. If you want these handled, they need a new red phase.
